items.q: In which part of the cell does glycolysis take place?
items.qAf: In watter deel van die sel vind glikolise plaas?
items.explain: Glycolysis splits glucose into pyruvate in the cytoplasm and needs no oxygen.
items.explainAf: Glikolise splits glukose na piruvaat in die sitoplasma en benodig geen suurstof nie.

items.q: What is produced by anaerobic respiration in human muscle cells?
items.qAf: Wat word deur anaërobiese respirasie in menslike spiersel geproduseer?
items.explain: Muscle cells without enough oxygen convert pyruvate into lactic acid.
items.explainAf: Spiersels sonder genoeg suurstof omskep piruvaat in melksuur.

items.q: Yeast in a sealed container without oxygen produces:
items.qAf: Gis in ’n toe houer sonder suurstof produseer:
items.explain: Yeast uses alcoholic fermentation, giving ethanol and CO₂.
items.explainAf: Gis gebruik alkoholiese gisting en gee etanol en CO₂.

items.q: Why does anaerobic respiration release less energy per glucose than aerobic respiration?
items.qAf: Hoekom stel anaërobiese respirasie minder energie per glukose vry as aërobiese respirasie?
options: Glucose is only partly broken down
items.explain: Without oxygen, the Krebs cycle and electron transport chain do not run, so most energy stays in the products.
items.explainAf: Sonder suurstof loop die Krebs-siklus en elektronoordragketting nie, dus bly meeste energie in die produkte.

items.q: Which stage of aerobic respiration produces the most ATP?
items.qAf: Watter stadium van aërobiese respirasie maak die meeste ATP?
items.explain: Most ATP is made by oxidative phosphorylation in the electron transport chain.
items.explainAf: Meeste ATP word deur oksidatiewe fosforilering in die elektronoordragketting gemaak.

items.qAf: Respirasie stel energie hoofsaaklik vry om:
items.explain: The energy is captured in ATP, which powers cell processes.
items.explainAf: Die energie word in ATP vasgevang, wat selprosesse aandryf.
